1.consolidated_definition: Extraviarse. Desaparecerse una persona, animal o cosa. También dicen esgaritarse.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To stray or wander off course; to disappear from sight or knowledge, a person, animal, or object. Also said to esgaritarse.
